review_method: Independent cold inspection using vision_analyze on each of the 25 original images; review-ledger.json consulted only afterward to reconcile existing holds.
limitations: Static endpoint images do not establish animation clearance, hidden faces, hinge contact or topology.
Marketing is promotional illustration, not exact-model or interior equivalence evidence.
Mobile captures do not establish physical-phone behavior.
No source inventory rerun, art changes, approval changes or kanban transitions.

observations.desktop_closed: Two pale rocky mountain masses, green slopes and turquoise channel above a slate-blue striated chest; brass corner caps, clasp, plain round disc, side ring and irregular stone feet remain visible.
observations.desktop_open: Empty patterned cavity, green rim and striated lid underside are visible. Dark separation beneath the raised lid leaves rear attachment ambiguous.
observations.mobile_closed: Peaks, feet and hardware remain within frame; title wraps without colliding with model or controls.
observations.mobile_open: Complete open silhouette, readable cavity and separated controls; stepped rim joins and hinge contact cannot be resolved at this scale.
observations.marketing: Same twin-mountain/channel composition, slate flowing-line body, green seam, brass and stone feet. The green lid reveal is already present here.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime green slopes are more visibly triangular and transitions to pale rock and water are abrupt.
Dense regular wall striations read flatter and more laminated than the promotional surface; water is a simpler turquoise strip.
unresolved_visual_questions: Open rear hinge connection appears separated; no still proves detachment or an incorrect pivot.
Crowded front clasp and stepped rim joins merit close-up inspection, not a confirmed collision finding.
holds_preserved: Full historical source inventory not verified; existing New Zealand decision hold retained.
entries.reason: Bounded visual candidate pass does not clear the inherited historical-source hold or constitute user approval.

observations.desktop_closed: Blue watery body, ivory atoll ring, turquoise lagoon and jagged dark rock are legible; brass clasp/disc/caps, side ring and dark stone feet remain coherent.
observations.desktop_open: Empty blue-patterned interior and lid underside, pale rim and two rear hinges visible; pattern discontinuities at panel boundaries are conspicuous.
observations.mobile_closed: Whole chest, atoll and feet fit; title and controls do not overlap. Clasp components are visually crowded but no penetration is established.
observations.mobile_open: Full open silhouette and readable cavity; rim layers look uneven at corner joins, without definite missing surfaces or clipping.
observations.marketing: Broad pale blue-gray lid, ivory ring around cyan depression and small dark peak; watery teal body, gold fittings and dark rounded supports.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime lid has stronger watery blue mottling and less uniform pale coverage than marketing.
Runtime body ripples are high contrast; ring and rock are angular and simplified. These are finish/fidelity differences rather than demonstrated broken geometry.
unresolved_visual_questions: Acceptability of pale-lid coverage and terrain treatment requires user decision.
Rear hinge/rim attachment and clasp clearance cannot be certified from endpoint views.
holds_preserved: Existing pale-lid coverage and terrain-treatment decision hold.
entries.reason: Theme and framing are intact, but inherited fidelity decision remains unresolved.

observations.desktop_closed: Rounded stepped terrace mound, pale stone body and yellow-green terrace tops; green seam, brass clasp/disc/corner caps, side ring and gray irregular feet.
observations.desktop_open: Empty pale mottled cavity with green rim and patterned lid underside; two rear hinges visible, but their exact contact is unresolved.
observations.mobile_closed: Terraced silhouette remains complete; title, controls and disclaimer do not overlap the model.
observations.mobile_open: Cavity and green rim read coherently; front-right rim corner looks slightly protruding, not a proven mesh intersection. No viewport clipping.
observations.marketing: Same stepped oval mound and sage terrace tops, cloudy gray body, dark green seam, brass fittings and rounded gray feet.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime has more repetitive wavy stone banding and slightly warmer/yellower terrace tops than the softly cloudy promotional surface.
Tier edges and rock feet are more angular; this does not establish missing or broken geometry.
unresolved_visual_questions: Rear hinge contact and corner trim joins require other angles for mechanical certification; projecting free-edge tab is consistent with released front clasp.
entries.reason: Required originals retain terrace identity, hardware and stone feet with complete framing and no unequivocal structural defect. Candidate only.

observations.desktop_closed: Large crater-like island and smaller pointed green island on turquoise water with cream shores; charcoal streaked body, brass fittings and dark block feet.
observations.desktop_open: Empty gray-green cavity and turquoise rim remain readable. Dark gap below the raised slate lid makes the hinge/body connection visually ambiguous.
observations.mobile_closed: Both peaks, body and feet remain visible; long title wraps cleanly and does not collide with the viewer.
observations.mobile_open: Complete open chest with no UI overlap; rear-right rim looks stepped and small hinge joins cannot be resolved.
observations.marketing: Same two-island composition, cream shorelines, aqua water, slate body, gold clasp/plain disc/corner caps and chunky body-colored feet.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime slopes and shorelines are more schematic and faceted, with flatter turquoise water.
Diagonal body streaking resembles brushed material rather than rough volcanic rock; neither is established damage.
unresolved_visual_questions: Conspicuous desktop rear lid/hinge separation needs rear/side contact evidence or explicit acceptance; not a proven detached lid.
holds_preserved: Existing unresolved rear lid/hinge attachment appearance hold.
entries.ledger_reconciliation: Ledger reports rotated runtime follow-up did not demonstrate broken geometry; that is historical evidence, not a fresh inspection here, and does not clear hidden contact or the decision hold.
entries.reason: Identity and framing survive, but the independent open-view concern supports retaining the existing review hold.

observations.desktop_closed: Crimson/pink panels with ivory/navy diamonds and stepped lid rosettes; brown framing, brass clasp/disc/corner caps, left ring and brown block feet.
observations.desktop_open: Plain brown empty cavity and lid underside; rear lid gap and dark rim joins look visually exposed, without conclusive evidence of failed attachment.
observations.mobile_closed: Patterned panels and full chest silhouette remain legible; no viewport clipping or UI collision.
observations.mobile_open: Cavity remains aligned in perspective and model stays clear of instructions and buttons; hinge details are too small for mechanical certification.
observations.marketing: Coral-pink panels, cream/navy diamond repeats and large stepped lid rosettes with warm brown frame, gold hardware and block feet. Border cropping also exists in this reference.

finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime textile reads brighter crimson/magenta versus dusty coral marketing; brown frame and inner surfaces are flatter and more uniform.
Cropped border motifs are shared design treatment, not established texture loss. Plain open underside is not disappearance of exterior ornament.
unresolved_visual_questions: Rear hinge contact appears open or offset in desktop view, but exact contact and motion clearance are unproven; a raised front-clasp tab alone is not detached rear hardware.
entries.reason: Bounded candidate pass for identity, complete framing and intact visible cavity; no unequivocal structural defect established, no final approval.
